description: This Java class `DefaultProtocolConfig` is an implementation of the `ProtocolConfig` interface, representing configuration details for a protocol in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to instantiate the configuration from a `Config` object, and accessors for provider class name and blocked header keys.

classes.name: DefaultProtocolConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ProtocolConfig, encapsulating protocol provider and blocklist configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultProtocolConfig from a Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getProviderClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the protocol provider.

methods.name: getBlockedHeaderKeys
methods.description: Returns the set of header keys that are blocked.
